items.detail: Westin Studio, one king, non-smoking. ¥1,464 + ¥243.02 service = ¥1,707.02 all in (~$240). ¥732 prepayment charged 27 Sep; free to cancel until 23:59 on the 28th. 66 Ci En Road, Qu Jiang New District, +86-29-65686568 — opposite the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, Dayanta station on Lines 3 and 4. Line 4 runs straight to Xi'an Railway Station with no changes, which was the whole argument for this hotel.
items.name: The Westin Xi'an

items.detail: One night on the 85k Amex Brilliant free-night award, taxes included, nothing to pay. Free to cancel until 23:59 on 17 Sep — but you need this night: the Z165 leaves at 09:27 on the 2nd. Ask the front desk to LINK the two reservations so you aren't moved rooms on the morning of the 1st. Platinum on both: 1,000-point welcome gift or F&B, lounge access, upgrade subject to availability, plus free entry to the hotel's own Xi'an Qujiang Museum of Fine Arts and free Hanfu wear.

items.detail:
锦江都城南京饭店 · No. 200 Shanxi South Road, Huangpu · 上海黄浦区山西南路200号 · +86 21 6322 2888.

Booked on Trip.com 16 September, $102.14 prepaid by Apple Pay, Fashionable Twin Room, two twin beds, one night. Hotel confirmation 109750832349. Free cancellation until 18:00 on 9 October, nothing back after that. A deposit is taken at check-in and refunds on a card take two to four weeks.

THE LOCATION IS THE WHOLE POINT: five minutes from Nanjing East Road station, eleven minutes' walk to the Bund, fifteen to People's Square. Sunday is a walking day because of where this hotel is.

Breakfast is NOT included — ¥98 at the door, 06:30–10:00. Eat on Nanjing Road instead.

Leave the bags at the desk when you check out on Sunday morning; you come back past the door at the end of the day.
items.name: Metropolo Nanjing Road Nanjing Hotel

items.detail:
玩具总动员酒店 · No. 360 Shendi West Road, Pudong · 上海浦东新区申迪西路360号 · +86 21 2099 8003.

Booked on Trip.com 16 September, $659.80 prepaid by Apple Pay, Garden View Room, two full beds, four nights. Hotel confirmation W107837385-1HMC. Free cancellation until 19:00 on 8 October.

TWO THINGS COME WITH IT THAT YOU WOULD OTHERWISE PAY FOR. Early park entry, up to an hour before public opening, used at the Disneytown entrance between 07:30 and 08:30 — the hotel issues it, no booking needed. HOW MANY MORNINGS IS DISPUTED: this booking says once per room across the stay, resort policy for bookings after 17 June 2025 says once per guest per night. Disneyland has the full argument. Ask at the desk on Sunday, plan for one morning and be pleased. And a round-trip Disneytown shuttle, once per room. Ask for both at check-in.

GETTING THERE AND BACK: a hotel shuttle runs between the metro station and the hotel 06:45–23:00, every twenty minutes. Breakfast is ¥178 a head and not included.

The name on the booking cannot be changed, and the person named has to be the one at the desk.
items.name: Toy Story Hotel
